en: Gloomy forecast from Swiss Re: Insured losses are heading inexorably towards the $200 billion mark. Climate change, inflation and unstoppable urbanization are driving the costs of earthquakes, hurricanes and wildfires to astronomical levels worldwide. But while losses are rising rapidly, the insurance industry is retreating from the extreme risk areas...
